English Portfolio

Welcome to my English Portfolio. This website collects the work I have done in English class this term: exercises from Units 9, 10, 11 and 12, plus grammar practice and writing tasks. The topics are technology and workplace communication.

Erik Taboada · WG31 2026

Unit 9 · Software

Vocabulary about software: cash flow, cloud, database, subscription, free trial and licenses, plus conditionals and definitions.

Unit 10 · Internet

The Internet and web searching (hyperlink, ranking, advanced search, URL), choosing the right device for each person, and reading comprehension.

Unit 11 · Graphics

Graphic software: brightness, contrast, layers and retouching photos.

Unit 12 · Word

Microsoft Word: the parts of the window, Home and Page Layout functions, and related vocabulary.

Grammar

Past simple, past continuous and future forms (will, going to, present simple and present continuous) in workplace and IT contexts.

Writings

Two writing tasks: describing a product and replying to an email.

My Favourite Telephone App

My favourite telephone app is Spotify. It is designed to listen to music and podcasts. I like it because I can listen to my favourite songs whenever I want.

Spotify has many useful functions. You can search for songs, create playlists and discover new artists. It is easy to use because its design is simple. You only need an internet connection to listen to music online.

One of its best features is that you can download songs and listen to them offline with a Premium account. Another advantage is that it recommends music based on your tastes. However, one disadvantage is that the free version has advertisements and some limitations.

I use Spotify when I am studying, travelling or relaxing at home. It is useful because I can listen to different types of music in one place.

Overall, I would recommend this app because it is practical, entertaining and easy to use.

Email reply to Andy

Dear Andy,

This sounds like a really interesting project, and I am looking forward to working with you on this.

Productivity app

The app I use most often is Trello. In my experience, it is easy to use and everybody can understand it quickly. Its main features are boards with lists and cards, deadlines, checklists, attached files and comments.

Email communication

I think one short update a week, for example on Fridays, would be enough. If something is urgent, we can send an extra email. I would suggest copying everybody on important updates, but not on small questions.

Research

I would be happy to do the search on similar platforms. I can send you a short summary of what our client’s competitors are doing by the end of next week.

Shall we arrange a call to discuss this further?

Kind regards,
Diya
